svg.text: DIMENSIONED MECHANICAL DRAWINGS · DERIVED FROM pi-stack-v0.7.scad
1. Port openings are slots cut down through the MID's
bottom edge (z 5.70), so the MID drops over
plugged connectors. The BASE rim closes them below.
2. The BASE has NO port cuts: its rim stops at z 5.50.
3. Panel row is at z 33.00; LED and switch
4. Both butt joints carry a 0.20 axial gap;
screw preload closes it. Joints 5.50/5.70 and 40.60/40.80.
5. The plate hangs 0.50 below the case and
6. Detail positions are dimensioned on sheet 7 (MID);
the plate is sheet 5 and the BASE is sheet 6.
Ports, panel row, accessory opening, BASE vents, plate below
